sources.name: Satellite · Esri World Imagery
sources.description: Satellite and aerial imagery. Metre-or-better detail in many areas; resolution and capture dates vary by location. Uses the service’s full tile pyramid.

sources.name: Streets · OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Roads, place names, buildings and paths. Cartographic detail through zoom level 19.

sources.name: Offline · NASA Blue Marble
sources.credit: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation · July 2004
sources.description: Bundled world overview, about 1.2 km per pixel at the equator (the full resolution of the bundled NASA source). Coarse fallback only; no detailed ground imagery.
